title: vernonella subaphylla
intro: Vernonella subaphylla, commonly known as Vernonella, is a type of plant species. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Vernonella subaphylla include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
